Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Madhuri Sethi. I am a 43-year-old college lecturer living in Coimbatore. Pooja Goyal gave me a cheque for INR 13,90,000/- to repay a loan, but the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. My case number is S.C.C. No. 2540/2019 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Coimbatore. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 91972 49852 or email madhuri.sethi@example.com.
